ui.hint.ready: Your board has moved on. Ask for the next hint when you want it.
ui.hint.allRight: Everyone stands on the right tile. Press Submit.
ui.hint.look: Look at {name}. The tiles that fit the clue are marked on the board.
ui.hint.direct: The suspects on the board already take or watch every other tile that fits {name}'s clue.
ui.hint.shadowLook: Everyone is placed. Find the one tile no suspect watches: S. H. Adow hides there.
ui.hint.shadowLookMany: Everyone is placed. Find the {n} tiles no suspect watches: the assassins hide there.
ui.hint.wrongLook: Something on your board does not add up. Check your tokens and marks against the clues.
ui.hint.wrongZone: Look again at your marks in the {zone}.
ui.hint.wrongCross: Someone is on {coord}: the X there is wrong.
ui.hint.wrongLight: Someone hides on {coord}: the light there is wrong.
ui.howto.undoHint: **↩️ Undo** takes back the last move (Ctrl/⌘ Z). **🔎 Hint** helps in three steps: where to look, the key deduction, then the placement. It also points out a mistake on your board.
